request.deadline: instantly performed as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: Immediate on-chain distribution of funds to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action and compensate estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for estimated lost staking rewards.
The submitter of the September 2024 'Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -' Info governance action was unable to recover a 100,000 ADA deposit because of a Cardano node bug involving an unregistered stake key.
The referenced Ikigai governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement of thanks and hope for Cardano's future.
The proposer states there was significant community sentiment that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in a budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposal states that the recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposer states there are no costs or expenses associated with this treasury withdrawal and no circumstances under which the withdrawal would be refunded to the treasury.
The proposer states that community auditability is available on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The document references an AdaStat governance page for the prior Ikigai governance action.

summary: The document requests a 103,000 ADA treasury reimbursement for a prior unrecovered governance action deposit, asserting a node-bug cause, community support, NCL compliance, and direct on-chain delivery, but it provides limited supporting analysis beyond a reference to the prior governance action.
